abstract.t: This document describes the Namespace Identifier (NID) 'mplify' for Uniform Resource Names (URNs) used to identify resources published by Mplify Alliance. Mplify specifies and manages resources that utilize this URN identification model. This URN namespace will complement the existing "mef" URN namespace registered in RFC 7818. Management activities for these and other resources types are handled by the manager of the Mplify Assigned Names and Numbers (MANN) registry.

section.title: Introduction
section.t: Mplify Alliance (https://www.mplify.net/), formerly MEF Forum, is a global alliance of enterprises, service providers, cloud providers, data center operators, technology providers, and systems integrators, working together to accelerate the AI-powered digital economy through standardization, automation, certification, and collaboration.

Mplify is the defining body for Carrier Ethernet, Lifecycle Service Orchestration (LSO) APIs, and certified SASE and SD-WAN. Mplify has developed the global blueprint for Network-as-a-Service (NaaS) that is empowering the industry to innovate, interoperate, and scale trusted network services across a global ecosystem.

In June 2025, MEF Forum became Mplify Alliance. The "mplify" URN namespace is being registered to provide persistent, unique identifiers for resources published under the Mplify Alliance brand, complementing the existing "mef" URN namespace registered in URN Namespace for MEF Documents. To ensure that this namespace's uniqueness is absolute, a registration of a specific Unified Resource Name (URN) Uniform Resource Nmaes (URNs) Namespace Identifier (NID) for use by Mplify is being specified in this document.

The existing "mef" URN namespace remains valid. URNs previously assigned under "urn:mef:*" continue to be valid and will not be reassigned or retired. New resources will be assigned URNs under the "mplify" namespace.

ul.li: registration date: YYYY-MM-DD (Note to RFC Editor: Please add the registration date when this request gets accepted and remove this instruction)
Address: 12130 Millennium Dr, Suite 300, Los Angeles CA 90094 USA
The syntax of namespace specific strings for the 'mplify' namespace is <NSS> in RFC 8141.
Assignment of a URN from the Mplify namespace will be documented as part of the Mplify Assigned Names and Numbers (MANN) registry.
The namespace is not listed with an Resolution Discovery System (RDS). Therefore this process is not relevant.
Mplify publishes information regarding the registered resources in the Mplify Assigned Names and Numbers (MANN) registry (https://www.mplify.net/MANN).

section.title: Security Considerations
section.t: There are no additional security considerations other than those normally associated with the use and resolution of URNs in general, which are described in Function Requirements for URN, Uniform Resource Names (URNs).

section.title: IANA Considerations
section.t: This document adds a new entry ("mplify") in the urn-namespace registry. This is the defining document. When published, the entry can be found in the "Uniform Resource Names (URN) Namespaces" registry available from the IANA site (https://www.iana.org) and any associated mirrors.
